name: tavily-list
description: Build a deduplicated table of matches for a set, using Tavily. The table is what search returned, not every match that exists. Use when the user wants a list, all of something, or a table with duplicates removed. Confirm the columns and a cap before searching. For one CRM record, or a CSV of rows they already have, use tavily-entity. For a deep comprehensive report use tavily-research.
